method: Assistant qualitative inspection of fresh viewer screenshots, with the user-provided photos as contour references. The photos supply no registered dimensions and do not establish scanned or person-specific skin.
reviewScope: Current geometry: desktop 1440 px, High graphics, light theme and 100% skin opacity for anterior/lateral whole-limb views and ankle/heel/toe closeups on both sides. Cap captures cover both sides, light/dark, proximal/seam, on/off at 100% opacity. The historical mobile, transparency and all-angle matrix was not rerun for this revision.

fullerContoursAndKnee.note: Calf/thigh contours are fuller and the anterior patellar pad reduces the skeletal knee contour. This is an illustrative envelope, with some structure-derived surface relief remaining.

ankleAndHeelLandmarks.note: Rounder heel and smoother ankle/Achilles transitions are visible. The original thin 2-4 mm landmark distance targets fail and are recorded separately.

toeGaps.note: All four actual mesh section gap criteria pass on each side. Distal clefts are visible; normal proximal toe webs remain.

noFlapsAndThinBridges.note: The previously ragged toe-web strips are absent in the reviewed fresh dorsal closeups; rounded toe surfaces and continuous separators replace voxel-carved edges.

capControls.note: Fresh 16-cap capture run verifies on/off at proximal and seam cuts in both themes. Independent opacity and combined seam hiding are covered by existing tests.

historicalReview.note: These captures describe the previous geometry and its rejected ragged toe webs. They are not current-revision validation.

subsequentRuntimeRevision.note: User feedback rejected the previous interaction lag and smooth/clay appearance. The runtime revision supersedes the presentation review; the geometry and its historical scoped review remain unchanged.
